title: nixos/neo4j: add ssl.policies.<name>.enable
structural_notes: Diff adds a new `enable = lib.mkEnableOption "this policy";` declaration line (line 471 at head) inside the ssl.policies.<name> submodule under options.services.neo4j.ssl.policies = mkOption { type = attrsOf (submodule ({name,config,options,...}: { options = { enable = ...; allowKeyGeneration = ...; ...}; })); }. The rendered-config `let` binding sslPolicies also changed from iterating `cfg.ssl.policies` to `lib.filterAttrs (_: v: v.enable) cfg.ssl.policies`, and per-policy config gained a new `dbms.ssl.policy.${name}.enabled=...` line. Watched: baseline `enable` (services.neo4j.enable, untouched by this diff, included per standing instruction) via target 'neo4j', plus the new per-policy `enable` via target 'neo4j-ssl-policies' with option_prefix ["services","neo4j","ssl","policies","*"] (attrsOf-submodule wildcard pattern, matching the shape used for prior batches' gitlab-runner-services target). nixos/tests/neo4j.nix (both base and head) sets only services.neo4j.enable = true, services.neo4j.https.enable = false, services.neo4j.bolt.enable = false -- it never configures any named entry under services.neo4j.ssl.policies, so no test instance of the wildcard submodule exists in either root.
